_comment: List prices applied by bench/resources.py. Read from the pages below on date_read. Prices are strings so the cost arithmetic stays exact.

s3_standard_storage.page_text: S3 Standard - General purpose storage ... First 50 TB / Month $0.023 per GB
s3_standard_storage.gb_definition: 1 GB = 1,073,741,824 bytes, from the GB-Month worked example in the Amazon S3 FAQ: '(1 GB / 1,073,741,824 bytes)'

athena_sql_queries.page_text: SQL queries $5.00 per TB of data scanned. ... You are charged for the number of bytes scanned per query, rounded up to the nearest megabyte, with a 10 MB minimum per query.
athena_sql_queries.rounding: bytes scanned per query rounded up to the nearest megabyte
athena_sql_queries.unit_definition: The Athena pricing page and the Athena FAQ do not define TB or MB in bytes. Binary units are applied (TB = 2^40 bytes, MB = 2^20 bytes), matching the 2^30-byte GB in the Amazon S3 FAQ.
